zhCN.name: 军团打击
zhCN.description: 歼灭者萨祖克斯用战斧猛烈挥击，造成533403点物理伤害，并使目标受到的治疗效果降低80%，持续8秒。

enUS.name: Legion Strike
enUS.description: Xathuux the Annihilator performs a powerful swing with his axe that inflicts 533403 Physical damage and reduces healing received by 80% for 8 sec.

zhCN.name: 毁灭猛击
zhCN.description: 施法者对当前目标造成533403点物理伤害和145474点自然伤害。

enUS.name: Crushing Smash
enUS.description: The caster inflicts 533403 Physical damage and 145474 Nature damage to its current target.

zhCN.name: 邪能飞弹
zhCN.description: 朝敌人发射混乱飞弹，每1秒造成火焰伤害，持续5秒。

enUS.name: Fel Missiles
enUS.description: Launches disorderly missiles at an enemy, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec for 5 sec.

zhCN.name: 凡尘之羁
zhCN.description: 疑之煞淡出现实世界，受到的伤害降低99%，并强迫所有敌人面对他们各自的疑惑。
